name: view_scale_is_set_and_followed
why: REPORT 8CD843, ROUND 21, POINT 1 (28/10/2026). On the real drawings of 26M000002 «standard_views» put a part 175 mm long at 1:2 on an A3 with the sheet at 1:1 (args21 003, 006), and nothing could change it: «standard_views» and «model_view» had no «scale», and no operation scaled a view already on the sheet. Now «scale» on both and «set_view_scale»; the projected views must follow their parent.
defect_caught: A scale asked and not set, or set and not read back; a projected view left at the old scale when its parent changes; a view scaled again to the scale it has, or by a scale that cannot be read, or on a view that is not there, answered as done.
_why_these_numbers: A plate 175 x 40 x 20 mm, the length of 26P000007: at 1:1 its three views fit an A3 (420 x 297 mm), at 1:2 they are half as big. The isometric view at 1:4 is a quarter, 0.25.
